source.title: The Librarian's Apprentice
source.description: Your discovery of the Essence of Fire has greatly expanded our knowledge of the arcane. I have heard rumors of a similar power in Winterspring, though it is of a Frost nature. My associate in Everlook will have more information regarding the specifics.
source.objective: Speak with Valxx Cracklequil in Everlook to learn about the rumors.
source.completion:
So you've been sent by those old bats at the library, huh? They don't like me a whole lot, saying that 'gunpowder and magic don't mix.' Pah.

Yeah, I know a thing or two about what you're asking about. Lucky for you I'm too busy to look into it myself.
